capture.setup: same lab root -> issuing CA ECDSA P-384 (SHA-384) -> leaf haproxy.fxlab.test ECDSA P-256 (SAN haproxy.fxlab.test, 127.0.0.1, 30 days); HAProxy `bind :8443 ssl crt haproxy.pem` (leaf + intermediate + key)
capture.command: certificate.Probe(host 127.0.0.1, port 18443 -> container :8443, serverName haproxy.fxlab.test) from the OpenMap certificate collector, run by a throwaway lab program; chain.pem and handshake.json written as for the nginx capture

files.name: chain.pem
files.description: certificate chain exactly as presented in the handshake (leaf first), PEM of the DER bytes

files.name: handshake.json
files.description: negotiated TLS version, cipher suite, SNI and the Probe verification result against the capture host's system roots

files.name: lab-root-ca.crt
files.description: public certificate of the lab root CA (not presented by the server; the trust anchor for chain verification)
